name: Intel Extension for PyTorch (IPEX) - GitHub README
notes: CRITICAL: Repository archived by owner on Mar 30, 2026. Read-only. Intel will not provide or guarantee development, support, maintenance, bug fixes, new releases or updates. Patches no longer accepted. Known security issues identified. Retirement plan: IPEX 2.8 was the last quarterly release. Most features and optimizations for Intel platforms have been upstreamed into PyTorch itself. Intel strongly recommends using PyTorch directly going forward. IPEX was launched in 2020 to extend official PyTorch for Intel CPU and GPU platforms.
